Thanks for sending these. I reviewed the redlines and put inline comments in Acme_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf. High-level:
1) Section 9 (Data Use / Retention) — Acme requests a 30-day deletion window for short-run logs. We can commit to a 90-day default with a SOW addendum for 30 days for regulated pilots; the 30-day ask as a baseline is not acceptable for our standard infra and telemetry policies. Alternative language proposed in comment #3.
2) Section 12 (Indemnity) — Acme's proposed broad indemnity clause is not acceptable; propose limiting to direct third-party IP and gross negligence.

If Acme is comfortable with my proposed alternatives, I can sign off without exec escalation. If not, we should tee up a 1:1 with legal leadership — that will add 3–5 business days.

Action items for onboarding team:
- Marissa/Kim: prepare the sample CSV with the added remit_address_2 column and share by Thu 07/15 so ProcureIT can validate.
- Sean: confirm whether Acme is willing to accept the 90-day retention default with an SOW option for 30-day retention for the pilot.

Signature:
Laura Bennett
